message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Are you testing more print-in-place items for your DIY projects soon? Your video on a tiny catapult caught our attention here at EDXSO. We want to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This collaboration offers a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format, helping your audience discover practical school tech tools. Feel free to reply if a short call this month would suit you.
message.dm: Your video on testing useful tech caught our attention. We have an idea for an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video. Would you be open to chatting?
